context: A dad answers his young son's impossible questions
purpose: Teach: 次元/語ら/有る/迅速/ものすごい/左手/一家/よほど

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパ、宇宙の外側には何が有るの？四次元って本当に有るの？
lines.en: Dad, what's outside the universe? Does the fourth dimension really exist?
lines.style: Curious child asking big questions with wide-eyed wonder and rapid-fire delivery

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: うーん、それは次元の違う話でね、パパも上手く語らせてもらえないなあ。
lines.en: Hmm, that's a topic on a whole different dimension, even Dad can't really put it into words.
lines.style: Warm fatherly tone, thoughtful pauses, gentle and slightly amused, scratching head

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: じゃあさ、ものすごい速さで走ったら時間は止まる？
lines.en: Then hey, if I run at incredible speed, does time stop?
lines.style: Excited child voice, jumping to the next question without waiting, bouncing energy

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: おっ、よほど科学が好きなんだな。光の速さなら近づくけど、人間には無理だよ。
lines.en: Oh, you really must love science a lot. Near light speed maybe, but humans can't do it.
lines.style: Impressed but grounded, chuckling softly, patient teacher mode with affectionate surprise

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねえ、もし恐竜が生きてたら、僕の左手を噛む？
lines.en: Hey, if a dinosaur were alive, would it bite my left hand?
lines.style: Silly child imagination, giggling, holding up hand dramatically toward dad

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: ははっ、噛まれる前に迅速に逃げないとな。左手も右手も守らないと。
lines.en: Haha, you'd have to escape swiftly before it bites you. Protect both hands.
lines.style: Laughing warmly, playing along with the silly scenario, fatherly chuckle and exaggerated

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: パパは恐竜より強い？うちの一家で一番強い？
lines.en: Are you stronger than a dinosaur, Dad? The strongest in our whole family?
lines.style: Innocent admiration, completely sincere question, looking up at father with shining eyes

lines.speaker: ryosuke_dad
lines.jp: もちろん。一家を守るのがパパの仕事だからな。さあ、もう寝る時間だぞ。
lines.en: Of course. Protecting the family is Dad's job, after all. Now, time for bed.
lines.style: Mock-proud bravado softening into gentle bedtime command with affectionate finality
